about: Dollard-Des Ormeaux is an independent West Island city on the Island of Montréal, not a borough of the city of Montréal. It is a bilingual, largely residential suburb of parks and post-war streets between Pierrefonds-Roxboro and Pointe-Claire. Centennial Park is the main public landscape. About 48,000 people live in Dollard-Des Ormeaux.
